summary: A right-click menu built from an item list: actions, checkboxes, radios, groups, separators and nested submenus.

props.name: items
props.description: A discriminated union. `{ label }` is a plain action (plus optional `icon`, `shortcut`, `destructive`, `disabled`, `onClick`). `{ type: "separator" }` divides. `{ type: "group", label?, items }` wraps a `role="group"` block under a heading. `{ type: "checkbox", label, checked, onCheckedChange }` and `{ type: "radio", value, onValueChange, options }` are the stateful kinds. `{ type: "submenu", label, items }` nests, recursively.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the trigger, popup and items together. `squircle` steps the popup & item radius up one and adds `corner-shape`.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Depth on both the trigger and the popup.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Which end of an item its `icon` sits at. A `shortcut` always trails regardless.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks the menu from opening at all & dims the trigger.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled state. There is no `defaultOpen` - a context menu that starts open before anyone right-clicks was never demonstrated & makes no sense.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new state. Required for a controlled menu.

props.name: animate
props.description: The popup's fade in/out. Turn it off for an instant appearance, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the trigger's classes, so any Yumma CSS utility you pass wins.
